json_patches.new: Note: (1 - \sqrt{1-x^2})^2 = 2 - x^2 - 2\sqrt{1-x^2}, so \int_0^1 (y_1^2 - y_2^2)\,dx = \pi(\pi/2 - 1) \approx 1,79; the answer 8,1 = \pi(1 + \pi/2) corresponds to the alternative sign/region.
